title: Problem with parralax mapping of the World Map

posts.author: Slavyanin
posts.body:
So, I am new to RPG maker MZ and I found this tutorial on parralax mapping:
.
When I use this "method" of parralax mapping, for example, in outside type map it works perfectly fine. But I wanted to use it on Overworld type map and it just does not work. Is it an issue of pluggin or am I just being stupid?

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
There's no way any of us can say what you're doing wrong without seeing how your map is set up, its properties, the image you're using, etc.
I don't understand what the difference is - if you're using a parallax image instead of tiles in the map editor, where would you see anything that says "outside" vs. "world"? A map is a map.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
it might be something else:
by default the first map is already filled with tiles, only newly created maps are empty by default.
and if the map is not empty, you won't see the parallax.
so if you decided to make your first map into your world map, that would explain it - but as said above that is completely independent of which tileset is used on the first map.
